basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old Magic: The Gathering enthusiast from Baton Rouge, Louisiana. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to have a flexible schedule. I usually spend my afternoons and late nights online, diving into my hobbies. Outside of work, I enjoy painting, playing strategy games, and exploring new places. I'm currently single and always up for a good discussion about card mechanics or sharing my latest digital art project.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I’ve been playing Magic: The Gathering since college, where I was introduced to the game by my roommates. Over the years, I've honed my skills through countless matches and online tutorials. Although I'm not a professional player, I like to keep updated with current meta strategies and card rules.
